description: Appointment to the Post of Surveyor General
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mrs. P.K.L.S. Panduwawala, who is currently serving as the Surveyor General of the Survey Department of Sri Lanka, is scheduled to retire from the public service on 2026-08-20 upon reaching the age of mandatory retirement. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, to appoint                            Mrs. O.T.M.I. Thilakaratne, the most senior officer in the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Surveyors Service, who is serving as an Additional Surveyor General of the said Department, to the vacant post of Surveyor General with effect from 2026-08-20.
